prompt:

raw_response:
Strong profitability (operating margin ~44%) and comfortable liquidity (current ratio ~1.92) indicate solid operating and near-term balance-sheet strength. Leverage is moderate (liabilities/equity ~0.74) with very high retained earnings, but net profitability is materially lower than operating profitability, limiting the highest-tier designation.

DECISION: AA-
